elements.text: Optimizing what is fundamentally a cache of public data (chain) to minimize use of the cheapest resource (disk space) is absurd. A consequence of Satoshi's penchant for premature optimization. At this point both transaction policy and memory pooling are falling apart, becoming a Rub Goldberg of competing interests and non-solutions.
